title: JRE 2279 - Ky Dickens
guestBio: Ky Dickens is a filmmaker and documentarian. She is the host and creator of the "The Telepathy Tapes" podcast.
tldr: Ky Dickens is a filmmaker and documentarian who created and hosts The Telepathy Tapes podcast
The episode discusses her work exploring unexplained phenomena and paranormal experiences
Conversation covers documentary filmmaking and storytelling techniques for sensitive topics
They discuss the intersection of science and unexplained experiences in her research
Dickens shares her journey into documentarian work and podcast creation
The Telepathy Tapes explores accounts and experiences that challenge conventional understanding
recap:
Joe sits down with filmmaker and documentarian Ky Dickens on JRE 2279 to discuss her unique career path and her work exploring the paranormal through The Telepathy Tapes podcast and documentary projects. Dickens brings a thoughtful, investigative approach to subjects that most mainstream media outlets won't touch, combining rigorous documentary filmmaking with openness to unexplained phenomena.

The conversation centers on how Dickens approaches interviewing people about deeply personal and often stigmatized experiences. She explains the challenges of creating credible content about topics like telepathy and paranormal experiences without sensationalizing them or losing scientific credibility. Joe and Ky dig into what makes documentary work compelling when dealing with fringe subjects, discussing the responsibility filmmakers have to their subjects and audiences.

Dickens shares insights into her creative process and how The Telepathy Tapes evolved from a personal interest into a full podcast and multimedia project. The discussion touches on why these stories matter and why mainstream institutions often dismiss or ignore the experiences of people reporting paranormal phenomena. They explore the tension between mainstream skepticism and the lived experiences of people who claim to have experienced telepathic or other unexplained phenomena.

quotes: I wanted to create a space where people could share their experiences without judgment

The Telepathy Tapes exists because mainstream media refuses to take these experiences seriously
When you interview people about paranormal experiences, you realize how common these phenomena actually are
My responsibility is to the people sharing their stories, not to skeptics or believers
